exposure: in-target intrapartum glucose control (capillary glucose 3.5-6.5 mmol/l during intrapartum period)
outcome: neonatal hypoglycaemia (defined as treatment with intravenous dextrose therapy)
cohort: Pregnant women with type 1, type 2, or gestational diabetes and their neonates.
finding: After adjusting for neonatal factors, there was no significant association between in-target intrapartum glycaemic control and neonatal hypoglycaemia, regardless of diabetes type.
